description: nf-core/chipseq samplesheet context. Each ChIP row references a control row; samplesheet must include both.

read_length.help: Read length used to calculate MACS3 genome size for peak calling if `--macs_gsize` isn't provided. The schema accepts only 50, 75, 100, 150 or 200.

narrow_peak.help: Run MACS3 in narrowPeak mode. MACS3 is run by default with the --broad flag.

aligner.help: Specifies the alignment algorithm to use - available options are 'bwa', 'bowtie2' and 'star' (the schema's enum also lists 'chromap').

pipeline.name: nf-core/chipseq
pipeline.core_rule: Required columns are: sample, fastq_1. The design columns fastq_2, replicate, antibody, control and control_replicate follow. Inputs/IgG controls must also appear as rows with empty antibody, control and control_replicate.

validation_rules: sample is identical for the replicates of one experimental group; replicate is an integer that starts at 1 for each group. A re-sequenced library keeps the same sample and replicate values, and the pipeline merges its runs.

Each ChIP row carries antibody, control and control_replicate together: control is the sample name of the input/IgG control, control_replicate is that control's replicate number, and antibody is required whenever control is given (no spaces in any of them).
A control row (the input/IgG sample) has an empty antibody, control and control_replicate.
fastq_1/fastq_2 must be gzipped FASTQ files ending in .fastq.gz or .fq.gz; the pipeline detects single-end from a blank fastq_2.

population_priority: Identify ChIP vs Input rows from NExtSEEK metadata; emit Input rows first when possible.
Use accession_rows for fastq columns; pull antibody/control linkages from sample lineage when explicit.
